name: Leire Pajín, Aurelijus Veryga - Amendements de la commission compétente - vote séparé - Am 53
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: (4) ‘assistance’ means experts, modules, other response capacities, in-kind assistance, including relief materials or supplies, digital tools, as well as data and information provided by the Commission (e.g Aristotle, Copernicus, technical information from the Joint Research Centre, etc.) or technical assistance and support teams, together with any required equipment offers by Union institutions, agencies and bodies and other capabilities needed to mitigate the immediate consequences of a disaster or a crisis and to coordinate a common response;
